title: 'Before returning to Venezuela US oil companies will want to be given assurances' , analyst says
summary: Speaking with FRANCE 24's Sharon Gaffney, Colin Harding, a consultant on Latin America and the Caribbean and former Latin America Editor of the Independent, says that Trump's push to get US oil majors in Venezuela may encounter some resistance as companies 'will want to be given assurances about the legal framework, about security and about conditions'.
